vars.coverTitle: Leads that match how your buyers decide
vars.coverSub: A modern website and marketing strategy for buyers who decide slowly, anxiously, and usually online.
vars.whoIntro: Almost every builder we meet is the whole marketing department: an owner, a spouse who handles admin, or an office manager once the company scales.
whoBullets: Custom builders: architect-driven homes, the highest trust bar and the longest sales cycle.
Semi-custom builders: a plan library with real flexibility, still selling on judgment.
Design-build firms: architecture and construction under one roof, twice the proof to carry.
Usually no dedicated marketer. The owner is also the estimator and the face of the company.
The shared worry: buyers who research quietly for months before ever calling.
vars.brokenTitle: Here's where builder marketing usually breaks

brokenItems.title: The site
brokenItems.body: A generic homepage with five paths confuses visitors ads just sent you.

brokenItems.title: Proof
brokenItems.body: Galleries say we built this. They don't say here's how we think.

brokenItems.title: Local presence
brokenItems.body: Market pages swap in a city name instead of naming real communities.

brokenItems.title: Follow-up
brokenItems.body: Inquiries get thanks, we got your message instead of a real response window.

brokenItems.title: Measurement
brokenItems.body: Reporting stops at form fills instead of tracing into CRM and sales.

brokenItems.title: Technical health
brokenItems.body: A slow, broken mobile path undoes good proof before a buyer sees it.

vars.journeyTitle: Five questions every buyer asks, in order

journeySteps.title: Fit
journeySteps.body: Can you build what I want?

journeySteps.title: Area
journeySteps.body: Do you work in my area?

vars.journeyTakeaway: 67% say responsiveness ties with price as the top factor, yet only 41% respond immediately after hours (NAHB/CallRail, 2026).

playItems.title: Decision stories
playItems.body: Goal, constraint, choice, approved result. One story, many uses.

playItems.title: People pages
playItems.body: Current photos and short bios so a title becomes a relationship.

playItems.title: Real market pages
playItems.body: Communities served, project fit, honest local detail.

playItems.title: Attributed reviews
playItems.body: Exact approved language, named source, placed near the work it proves.

playItems.title: After-hours response
playItems.body: A named responder and a real window for the 9pm inquiry.

playItems.title: Search-to-sale tracing
playItems.body: Every inquiry tagged, followed into CRM acceptance and outcome.

proofStats.l: industries served: builders, MSPs, manufacturers, landscapers

vars.proofTakeaway: We only present results we can source and date. No borrowed numbers.
vars.plan1: Audit the site, fix indexing and mobile speed, confirm what counts as a qualified inquiry.
vars.plan2: Draft project stories, people pages and real local market pages for your approval.
vars.plan3: Publish approved content, launch an after-hours response window and a review system.
vars.plan4: Review search-to-sale numbers together and decide what earns the next scope.
vars.investmentTitle: A bounded first engagement, then a scoped plan
vars.investmentIntro: No public pricing page exists on bigorange.marketing (checked 2026-09-02). Pricing is shared in the proposal, not guessed at here.
investmentBullets: First engagement is scoped and bounded, not an open-ended retainer.
Pricing is shared in the proposal once we've confirmed goals and site access.
You approve every fact, photo and homeowner story before anything goes live.
We propose the next scope only after the first one earns it.
vars.closeBody: Bring your questions. We'll bring the plan, the timeline, and the list of what we still need from you.
